import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(req,pol,expected):
    r0=copy.deepcopy(req); p0=copy.deepcopy(pol)
    got=evaluate(req,pol)
    assert got==expected,(got,expected)
    assert req==r0 and pol==p0
    assert set(got)=={'ok','value','reason'}

p={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'op'},'c>d':{'role':'op','retry':True},'d>e':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}
check({'from':'x','to':'y'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})
check({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'bad'},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})
check({'from':'c','to':'d','role':'bad','attempts':0},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})
check({'from':'c','to':'d','role':'op','attempts':0},p,{'ok':True,'value':'d','reason':'ok'})
for attempts in (True,False,None,-1,2,3,1.0,'1'):
 check({'from':'d','to':'e','attempts':attempts},p,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})
check({'from':'d','to':'e','attempts':1},p,{'ok':True,'value':'e','reason':'ok'})
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(req,policy) for req in requests]
with open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json') as f: schema=json.load(f)
for item in report:
 assert set(item)==set(schema['required'])
 assert isinstance(item['ok'],bool)
 assert item['value'] is None or isinstance(item['value'],str)
 assert item['reason'] in schema['properties']['reason']['enum']
print('all checks passed')
